description: Search card names or Scryfall syntax. Supports exactName, maxManaValue, cardType, sort (edhrec or usd low-to-high), and up to 30 excludedNames. Exclusions filter the bounded result pool; narrow the query if too few remain. Optional WUBRG color identity and USD per-card price cap. C or blank colors means colorless only; omit colors for any identity. Repeated color letters are canonicalized. Returns up to20 results, Oracle text, prices (null when unknown), source and optional TCGplayer affiliate links. Show disclosure when displaying shopping links. Search is bounded and not an exhaustive recommendation. No purchases.
